name: sculpt-ready
description: Hand a freshly generated base shape over to the artist's stylus: even out the topology with a voxel remesh, put the object in Sculpt Mode, and set the brush up with symmetry on. Leave the object blank to use whatever is active.

object.description: The base shape to prepare. Blank means the active object, which is what a part that was just generated is

voxel_size.description: Remesh grid in Blender metres: 0.001 is a 1 mm grid — fine enough to sculpt into, coarse enough to stay quick. 0.0005 is half a millimetre and four times the faces

brush.description: The brush to hand them. Clay Strips builds form up; Draw, Smooth and Grab are the other three worth naming

symmetry_x.description: Mirror every stroke across X, so one ear is two

steps.label: Even out the topology so a brush pushes the same everywhere
